cases.title: Grandma's drought
cases.question: Is the soil in southern Ukraine drying out?
cases.teaser: Grandma says her garden needs more watering every year. Is she right?
cases.answer: Not proven. No clear trend yet in Southern Ukraine: the change so far is within normal year-to-year swings.
cases.headline: No clear trend yet

cases.title: Is Ukraine getting warmer?
cases.question: Is Ukraine getting warmer, and in which season the most?
cases.teaser: Winters without snow, summers that do not end. What do 45 years of data say?
cases.answer: Yes. Ukraine is about 2.4 °C warmer than in 1981. Summer looks fastest, but we cannot yet tell it apart from the other seasons.
cases.headline: Strong evidence: getting warmer

cases.title: Same rain, opposite ways
cases.question: Is the north of Europe getting wetter while the south dries out?
cases.teaser: One continent, two directions. Do the trends really differ?
cases.answer: Not clearly: we cannot yet tell the difference apart from natural swings (p = 0.42).
cases.headline: No clear difference yet

cases.title: Only the south?
cases.question: Is all of Ukraine drying out, or only the south?
cases.teaser: We chose this question before running the numbers, and we show the answer whatever it is.
cases.answer: No clear trend yet in Ukraine: the change so far is within normal year-to-year swings.
cases.headline: No clear trend yet
